mods.name: Craftable Enchantement
mods.description: Craft enchanted books directly in a crafting table using XP bottles, a book, and a thematic ingredient (e.g. flint & steel for Fire Aspect). Each enchantment level requires one more XP bottle. Fully survival-friendly and vanilla-balanced.

releases.notes:
## Craftable Enchantement v1.0.0

First release — craft any enchanted book directly in a crafting table.

### What's included
- 113 shapeless recipes covering **all vanilla enchantments** (weapons, armor, tools, bow, crossbow, trident, fishing rod + curses)
- Formula: **N XP Bottles + Book + thematic ingredient** → Enchanted Book level N
- No custom items, pure data-pack approach

### Compatibility
| | |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 1.21.11 |
| Fabric Loader | ≥ 0.19.3 |
| Fabric API | 0.141.4+1.21.11 |

### Installation
Drop the JAR in your \mods/\ folder alongside Fabric API.
